title: The caliph backed a lie he never told. Why? | Folio 4 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
Afshin spoke. Ahmad brought me a message from you, he said. Is it true that I may not kill him? And the caliph answered. It is my message. Then al-Mutasim reproached his general. Bu Dulaf was a servant of this house, he said. The better path would have been to set him free with honor. And then he added a line that is still quoted in Persian. Har kasi aan konad ke az asl o gowhar-e vey sazad. Everyone does what befits his root and his nature. Afshin left, defeated.

The full story: Folio 4: The Judge Who Lied to Save a Life — on our channel and on every podcast app.
